question: By what power and agency does the yoginī named Will operate up to the limit of māyā?
premises: A yoginī named Will is identified
Operation extends up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, operates up to the realm of māyā.
uncertainties: Syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and māyāntaṃ is compressed
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, with the siddhas, extends up to māyā by the supreme will.
